Question 1
?

Which of the following gives the area bounded by graph of the polar curve r=3sin⁡(3θ) for 2π3≤θ≤π?

a
 92∫2π/3πsin2⁡(3θ)dθ
b
 12∫π/22π/3sin⁡(3θ)dθ
c
 23∫2π/3πsin2⁡(9θ)dθ
d
 32∫π/3πsin2⁡(θ)dθ
e
 92∫π/3πsin2⁡(θ+3)dθ
Submit
